thread:
Nikki H: UX question re: Scorecard approval modal. The primary CTA says 'Approve as Pass' and secondary is 'Approve'. Users are confused about what the default label actually means for downstream analytics.
Ethan W: Oof. That phrasing sounds like we're forcing a label. Do we even expose label weights anywhere in the modal?
Nikki H: Not currently. The modal only shows the label name and a small toggle for 'Apply to all similar cases' which is overloaded.
l10n-bot: Reminder: string 'Approve as Pass' exists in en_US and fr_FR; translators asked for context.
Priya V: Design idea: show a compact legend under the header with label name + description + weight (if >1). Eg: "Pass (score: 1) — considered success for the test suite". Keep it visually subtle.
Sam R: Accessibility: make sure the legend is visible to screen readers and that the label name isn't the only thing announced. Also keyboard focus should land on primary CTA after confirming label.
Ethan W: Product question: do we support weighted labels today? We do in scoring engine but UI doesn't surface it. If we surface weight, product should decide default behavior for ambiguous approvals.
Nikki H: Proposal: two small copy changes + a dropdown for label scope:
- Primary CTA: 'Approve — mark as Pass'
- Helper line: 'This counts as Pass for this prompt set. We use label weights for aggregated scores.'
- Scope dropdown: 'This run only / All runs in this suite / All runs for this prompt set'
Priya V: Microcopy nit: avoid long sentences. Maybe: 'Counts as Pass in aggregated scoring.' Short and scannable.
l10n-bot: For translators: include examples of 'Pass' vs 'Pass (weight 2)' so context is clear.
Sam R: Keyboard behavior: if scope dropdown is present it should be tabbable before CTA. For screen readers read scope selection before confirming.
Ethan W: Backend items: API already stores label weights on the suite. We'll expose label_description and label_weight on the approval modal payload.
Nikki H: Action items:
- Priya: produce two mock variants (legend + weight visible and simplified line).
- Sam: ARIA & keyboard checklist.
- Ethan: API change to include label_description & label_weight.
- Nikki: decide default scope (leaning toward 'This run only').
Priya V: Will drop mocks in #design by EOD and include compact copy options.
Nikki H: Thanks — let's aim to include this in the next patch release."
